// @molis-ai/molis-work-plugin-sdk/page-globals: public API snapshot.
// Generated by `node scripts/gates/api-snapshot.mjs --update`; do not edit by hand. A change below is a change to what plugins and other callers can use:
// say what it means for them in the PR.

export type ComposerAttachmentState = {
    state: "attached";
    ref: string;
    title: string;
} | {
    state: "failed";
    reason: string;
};

export interface ComposerCommand {
    slash: string;
    label: string;
    hint?: string;
    run(): void;
}

export interface ComposerCommonOptions {
    entry: string;
    draft: {
        conversation: string;
    } | {
        adapter: ComposerDraftAdapter;
    };
    submitKeys?: false;
    controls?: readonly ComposerControl[];
    commands?: readonly ComposerCommand[];
    attachments?: {
        accept?: string;
        upload(file: File, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<ComposerAttachmentState>;
    };
    onMaterials?(): void;
    sources?: boolean;
    near?: () => (ActionSubject & {
        plugin_id?: string;
    }) | null;
    voice?: string;
    required?: () => string | null;
    submit(input: ComposerSubmission, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<ComposerOutcome>;
}

export type ComposerControl = {
    kind: "select";
    id: string;
    label: string;
    options: readonly {
        value: string;
        label: string;
    }[];
    value: string;
    change?(value: string): void;
} | {
    kind: "toggle";
    id: string;
    label: string;
    on: boolean;
    change?(on: boolean): void;
} | {
    kind: "button";
    id: string;
    label: string;
    run(): void;
};

export type ComposerDelivery = {
    readonly [Mode in AgentSteerMode]: {
        available: true;
    } | {
        available: false;
        reason: string;
    };
};

export interface ComposerDraftAdapter {
    read(signal: AbortSignal): Promise<string>;
    write(text: string): Promise<void>;
    sent?(): Promise<void>;
}

export interface ComposerHandle {
    setRunning(running: boolean): void;
    refresh(): void;
    focus(): void;
    insert(text: string): void;
    attach(files: readonly File[]): void;
    materials(): readonly ComposerMaterial[];
    destroy(): void;
}

export type ComposerOptions = ComposerCommonOptions & ({
    kind: "plain";
    labels: MwComposerLabels;
} | {
    kind: "ai";
    labels: MwComposerAiLabels;
    receiver?: () => {
        label: string;
        open?: () => void;
        reset?: () => void;
        resetLabel?: string;
    } | null;
    delivery?: () => ComposerDelivery;
    stop?(signal: AbortSignal): Promise<void>;
});

export type ComposerOutcome = {
    state: "sent";
    receipt?: AgentSteerReceipt;
} | {
    state: "failed";
    message: string;
    unreadable?: readonly {
        index: number;
        reason: string;
    }[];
} | {
    state: "unknown";
    check(): Promise<"sent" | "not-sent" | "unknown">;
};

export interface ComposerSubmission {
    text: string;
    materials: readonly ComposerMaterial[];
    delivery?: AgentSteerMode;
    controls: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
    request_id: string;
}

export type CopyLabels = {
    done?: string;
    failed?: string;
};

export type DropAccepts = (types: readonly string[], items: readonly DropItem[]) => boolean;

export type DropItem = {
    readonly kind: string;
    readonly type: string;
};

export type DropMark = (on: boolean) => void;

export type FollowState = "following" | "detached";

export interface InteractionClient {
    readonly composing: boolean;
    read(): InteractionValues;
    write(values: InteractionValues): void;
    showErrors(errors: Record<string, string>, options?: {
        focus?: boolean;
    }): void;
    focusField(fieldId: string): void;
    destroy(): void;
}

export interface InteractionClientHost {
    onChange?(change: {
        field: string;
        part?: string;
        value: InteractionValues[string];
    }): void;
    onAction?(id: string, button: HTMLButtonElement): void;
    onSubmit?(): void;
    onStep?(index: number, button: HTMLButtonElement): void;
    references?(source: string, query: string): Promise<{
        items: Array<{
            value: string;
            label: string;
            meta?: string;
        }>;
    }>;
}

export interface InteractionPicked {
    value: string;
    label: string;
}

export interface InteractionValues {
    [fieldId: string]: string | string[] | {
        picked: string[];
        other?: string;
    } | {
        date: string;
        time: string;
    } | InteractionPicked[];
}

export type MediaZoom = {
    fit(eased?: boolean): void;
    actual(): void;
    state(): MediaZoomState;
    fitsAtActual(): boolean;
    dispose(): void;
};

export type MediaZoomOptions = {
    onChange?: (state: MediaZoomState) => void;
};

export type MediaZoomState = "fit" | "zoomed";

export type Reflow = (list: Element, change: () => void) => void;

export type ScrollFollower = {
    readonly state: FollowState;
    pin(): void;
    toLatest(): void;
    resume(): void;
    restore(top: number): void;
    release(): void;
    dispose(): void;
};

export type ShowMoreOptions = {
    key: string;
    label: string;
    limit?: number;
    keep?: string;
};

export type StreamTextOptions = {
    reveal?: boolean;
    grow?: (kept: Element, next: Element) => boolean;
};

export type StreamTextResult = {
    kept: number;
    replaced: number;
    fresh: number;
    grown: number;
};
